texts.preamble: Durga Prasad @ Durga Singh Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 28 April, 2025 Author: Samit Gopal Bench: Samit Gopal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:65609 Court No. - 64 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 3011 of 2018
texts.facts: 4. The brief facts of the case are that on 18.5.1999 at about 11 AM, Sri R.B. Pal, the Food Inspector found the revisionist carrying milk for sale which was told to him to be mixed milk of buffalo and cow and on a suspicion of the same to be adulterated he stopped the revisionist and purchased 660 mili liter mixed milk on payment of Rs.8/- and prepared the receipt and other documents on which the revisionist endorsed his signature. Public present on the spot were asked to give their testimony but no one stood ready. The sample was then treated with solution of formalin and sealed in three bottles in equal quantity. The process of sealing and labelling was done and then one of the bottles was sent to the Public Analyst, U.P., Lucknow for analysis. The Public Analyst vide his report no.5845, dated 29.6.1999 opined that the said sample was deficient in milk fat by less than 38% and milk solid non fat by less than 8.5% and glucose was also present in the sample. Thereafter the application dated 19.7.1999 along with all the documents regarding sample for sanction of prosecution was given by the complainant to the C.M.O. The C.M.O has sent sanction for prosecution of the accused under the Food Adulteration Act and thereafter a complaint dated 7.8.1999 was filed by the said Food Inspector. 5. In the trial R.B. Pal, the Food Inspector was examined as P.W.1 under Section 244 Cr.P.C. Hari Mohan Verma, Senior Food Clerk in the office of C.M.O. was examined as P.W.2 under Section 246 Cr.P.C. 6. The accused in his statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. denied the prosecution case. In the trial in defence three witnesses were examined i.e. the accused himself as D.W.-1, Ram Kishun as D.W.-2 and Ravi Vajpayee as D.W.-3. He has been extended benefit of set of under Section 428 Cr.P.C. The present revision has thus been filed.
texts.arguments: 8. Learned counsel for the revisionist argued that the prosecution against the revisionist was drawn on an incorrect finding of the Public Analyst inasmuch as the prescribed standard of milk solid not fat is 8.5% whereas the same was found to be 7.4%. It is argued that there is no independent witness to support the prosecution. In defence three witnesses i.e. the accused himself as D.W.-1, Ram Durga Prasad @ Durga Singh Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 28 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138642715/ 2 Kishun as D.W.-2 and Ravi Vajpayee as D.W.-3 were examined. Ram Kishun (D.W.2) in his examination has stated that Durga Prasad is resident of his village and he has not done the business of milk ever but stated that 14 years back he had collected milk for being given to someone for his consumption. It is argued that there is nothing on record to show that the notice under Section 13(2) of the Act has been sent by the Food Inspector or received by the revisionist and as such valuable right of the accused/revisionist safeguarding his interest is violated. The defence of the revisionist in the matter is that he is not a businessman of milk and neither was the milk being taken for sell by him. In his defence he has appeared in the defence box himself as D.W.1 and has further produced two other witnesses in his statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. also. His specific case is that he is not a businessman of milk and milk was being taken by him for being given to someone for use in a house in a function which was asked for by the said person. Although the trial court has referred to the testimony of three defence witnesses but has not conclusively dealt with it and given its finding regarding their versions. 9. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and arguments and argued that the trial court has given cogent reasons for convicting the revisionist. 10. In defence the revisionist has appeared as D.W.1 and has stated that he is not a businessman of milk and neither was the milk being taken for sale by him.
